# `settings` — module reference

Rendered from the module's own manifest, and from nothing written by hand. What the module *does* is [its own page](../modules/settings/index.md).

| Licence tier | — |

## Activation

**This module cannot be switched off.** The configuration surface for every other module. A module that is off has no editable configuration, so switching this off would leave nothing on the platform configurable.

## Dependencies

| Module | Binding | What it means |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `auth` | yes | installs and migrates after it, and an operator cannot switch it off underneath this module |
